QUOTE: "the measured PGR falls significantly below it" METRIC: pgr_se ISSUE: With PGR 0.08 ± 0.08, the 0.15 difference from baseline is not statistically significant.
QUOTE: "the tight standard error confirms this gap is real" METRIC: pgr_se ISSUE: The PGR standard error (0.08) equals the estimate itself and is not tight, so it confirms nothing.
